== English errata comparison sources ==
The November 1998 Decipher Glossary (PDF pages 112–113) rules that the defending lone bounty hunter must be yours. It does not supply replacement card text. The official Advanced Rulebook v3.28 (PDF page 122) and the 2023 Appendix A (page 126) print the PC wording. The named-character sentence reads the same in both card-text states.
